def factor_vwap_sma_compression_light(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    window_base = 20
    window_short = 10

    # VWAP and SMA for short window
    vp_short = df_copy["close"] * df_copy["volume"]
    vwap_short = vp_short.rolling(window_short, min_periods=window_short).sum() / df_copy["volume"].rolling(window_short, min_periods=window_short).sum()
    sma_short = df_copy["close"].rolling(window_short, min_periods=window_short).mean()
    div_short = (vwap_short - sma_short) / sma_short.replace(0, np.nan)

    # VWAP and SMA for base window
    vp_base = df_copy["close"] * df_copy["volume"]
    vwap_base = vp_base.rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).sum() / df_copy["volume"].rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).sum()
    sma_base = df_copy["close"].rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).mean()
    div_base = (vwap_base - sma_base) / sma_base.replace(0, np.nan)

    # Simplified compression regime: low volume (below 20-day MA) and low range
    volume_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).mean()
    is_low_vol = df_copy["volume"] < volume_ma
    true_range = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    range_ma = true_range.rolling(window_base, min_periods=window_base).mean()
    range_low = true_range < range_ma
    is_compressed = is_low_vol & range_low

    factor = np.where(is_compressed, div_short, div_base)
    df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_compression_light"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_compression_light"]
description: Mutation of factor_vwap_sma_compression_tool: preserves the core price-volume coherence mechanism (VWAP-SMA divergence) and the adaptive window switching under compression. The key change is replacing the alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime call with a simple moving-average volume threshold, removing external tool dependency and improving interpretability. Compression remains defined as low volume (below 20-day MA) AND low range (below 20-day average true range), triggering a shorter 10-day window for earlier breakout capture. This simplification targets improved robustness and code clarity without altering the economic logic.
